institution: IIIT Una (Indian Institute of Information Technology, Una)
data_source: Careers360 student reviews and Q&A (aggregated public review data)
sample_size_caveat: Sample size is small (4 reviews), so confidence in this sentiment analysis is moderate rather than high.

key_positive_themes.notes: Unlike several newer IIITs (Vadodara, Kota, Trichy), IIIT Una already has its own permanent campus located in Saloh, Una, with dedicated admin and academic blocks.
Average package rose from 12.1 LPA (2022) to 15 LPA (2023); highest package reached 46.5 LPA on-campus and 60 LPA off-campus in 2023; described by a reviewer as 'the fastest growing IIIT.'
Extensive sports infrastructure including athletics track, football and cricket grounds, volleyball, table tennis, lawn tennis, basketball, badminton courts, plus indoor chess and carrom facilities.
Highest-rated category (4.4/5); students describe a vibrant environment with cultural and technical events, auditoriums, and social development opportunities.
Student-to-teacher ratio around 15:1, with a majority of faculty holding PhD degrees; faculty described as supportive and proficient.

key_negative_themes.notes: Lowest-rated category (3.5/5); quality of teaching described as only 'about average' despite well-qualified faculty.
Frequent CT1, CT2, and end-semester exam cycle described by some students as making the semester hectic.
Occasional water-clogging in hostel areas reported during the rainy season.

sample_reviews_analyzed.review_snippet: IIIT Una is the fastest growing IIIT, a must join college — own permanent campus, state-of-the-art labs, average package 15 LPA in 2023
Giving my college a good review as it is growing each year — decent academics, placements on the rise, average package 15 LPA
Just sometimes in rainy season water clogs in hostel
Mid term end term process make things hectic, but overall good when you get support

conclusion: Sentiment toward IIIT Una is strongly positive and stands out among the newer-generation IIITs for already having its own permanent campus and a rapidly improving placement trajectory. Campus life and sports facilities are particular strengths, while academics/teaching quality is the relative weak point, alongside minor infrastructure issues like seasonal hostel water-logging.
disclaimer: This analysis is based on a small sample of publicly available student reviews and Q&A threads (Careers360) as of the search date and is illustrative, not a scientifically exhaustive sentiment study.
